rv.q: But this is a different thing entirely, because End of the Rainbow is a proper two-act play (by Peter Quilter). There’s zero audience interaction, but a handful of songs breaking up what is in fact the pretty depressing story of Garland’s demise. Before we get onto the Jinkx Monsoon of it all, a bit of context on Garland herself.
A production that is, in most respects, exceptional.

The Talk of the Town, one of the most glamorous nightclub venues in London at the time, offered Garland a lucrative contract and the possibility of a comeback before wealthy audiences and celebrity admirers.

cn.t: Jinkx Monsoon delivers a demanding performance as Judy Garland that quickly proves her dramatic chops, capturing the chaos and sparkle of the icon's final London comeback in this well-received production.
